S8.description: Supplementary Table 8: Sun 2018 INTERVAL SomaScan pQTL instruments (n=3301) harmonised with FinnGen endometriosis (Outcome='Endometriosis'); TwoSampleMR layout, outcome effects on the exposure effect allele. Matching MR results are in Supplementary Table 1 (SupplementaryTable17__Table_S1.csv).

Guo2024-1.notes: ICAM2 rows of Table S8 (FinnGen endometriosis); Table S1 reports IVW with nsnp=2, beta 0.3299.

Guo2024-2.notes: RSPO3 single pQTL (rs2489623); Table S1 reports Wald ratio beta -0.2834.

Guo2024-3.notes: Table S8 lists 2 ICAM4 pQTLs (rs635634 T/C, rs72660908 G/C), but Table S1 reports a Wald ratio with nsnp=1 (beta 0.4188 = rs635634 alone). rs72660908 is a palindromic G/C SNP with eaf 0.45, presumably dropped by TwoSampleMR harmonisation; the table has no mr_keep column, so both label-matched rows are kept and the 2-SNP IVW recompute is not expected to match.

Guo2024-4.notes: ENG single pQTL (rs635634, ABO locus trans-pQTL); Table S1 Wald ratio beta 0.3711.

Guo2024-5.notes: CD200 = 'OX-2 membrane glycoprotein'; single pQTL (rs635634, ABO locus trans-pQTL); Table S1 Wald ratio beta 0.4658.

Guo2024-6.notes: LIFR single pQTL (rs635634, ABO locus trans-pQTL); Table S1 Wald ratio beta 0.2943.

Guo2024-7.notes: IGF1R single pQTL (rs635634, ABO locus trans-pQTL); Table S1 Wald ratio beta 0.4046.

Guo2024-8.notes: HCAR2 2 pQTLs (rs704, rs9564162; trans); Table S1 IVW nsnp=2 beta -0.2760.
